entries: Added an `f` (full diff) shortcut to the create-file tool review screen so new-file confirmations can open a full-screen diff view, matching the existing file-edit experience.

Added support for pasting the OAuth authorization code in print mode (-p) via the controlling terminal (/dev/tty on POSIX and CONIN$ on Windows) when stdin is consumed by a piped prompt, and made truly headless runs fail fast with an actionable message instead of blocking.

Improved responsiveness on large conversations (5000+ steps) in no flickering mode by switching hot-path line-count methods to pointer receivers, cutting the per-frame prefix-sum cost and eliminating sustained 99% CPU and keystroke lag.

Fixed print mode silently downgrading to the default model when --model cannot be resolved by hard-failing with a non-zero exit and listing the available models, while interactive sessions keep the fallback-with-warning behavior.

Fixed permission checks not respecting the allowlist for nested command substitutions, so a command like echo "$(dirname $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel))" now runs without prompting when echo and git are allowlisted, instead of double-counting the nested command and prompting for review.
Fixed the CLI keybindings file staying out of sync with /keybindings when new default bindings are introduced by persisting the injected defaults while preserving user overrides.
Fixed garbled builtin tool headers such as CodeSearch(4 files found...) by mapping generic tool steps back to clean summaries like Read(/path) and CodeSearch(query).

Fixed mcp manager failing to resolve tool schema paths in standalone mode and leaking MCP server subprocesses after shutdown, which previously caused panics and cleanup failures for custom agents loading MCP tools.
Fixed a data race and copy-on-write violation when updating subagent states by cloning their stats before in-place mutation, preventing corrupted step counts and status for parallel subagents.

title.zh-TW: 終端機不再卡頓，介面顯示與預覽更完善
title.en: Terminal becomes smoother, tool headers are clearer, and new files get full diffs

body.zh-TW: 當你長對話執行到 5000 步（step，AI 動作次數）以上時，終端機不再卡頓或吃滿 CPU。以前在不閃爍模式（no flickering mode，防止畫面更新閃爍的機制）下，長對話會因行數計算消耗大量資源而打字卡頓；現在優化計算後已徹底解決。另外，新建檔案確認時可按 f 開啟全螢幕的差異預覽（full diff，完整的更動對照），體驗與修改現有檔案一致。最後，對話裡的工具標題不再顯示 CodeSearch(4 files found...) 等混亂內容，改為 Read(/path) 般乾淨的摘要。就像看超長小說，以前越後面越難翻且目錄凌亂，現在每一頁都很順手、目錄整齊，還能隨時拉出全螢幕對照。
body.en: Your terminal stays responsive and typing stays buttery smooth even if your conversation goes over 5,000 steps (step, AI action counts). Previously, in no flickering mode, counting lines for long chats caused high CPU and lag on every frame; this logic has been optimized to resolve the bottleneck. Also, when confirming new file creation, you can now press f to open a full screen difference preview (full diff) to see complete changes, matching the experience of editing existing files. Finally, chat tool headers are cleaned up from messy strings like CodeSearch(4 files found...) to neat summaries like Read(/path). It's like reading a massive novel where pages used to get harder to turn, the index is clear, and you can pull out a full-screen comparison/diff view anytime.

title.zh-TW: 腳本模式更可靠，模型不偷換、授權不卡死
title.en: Print mode fails honestly on missing models and handles auth gracefully

body.zh-TW: 當你用腳本自動執行任務時，系統不再默默更換模型或卡死。在列印模式（print mode，印出答案即結束的執行方式）下，若指定的模型不存在，系統會立刻報錯中斷並列出可用清單，不再默默降級（但互動模式仍維持警告並使用備援模型（fallback，指主要方案失效時的替代方案）的舊規）。此外，用管線餵指令給腳本時，若需要登入，你可以直接在控制終端機（controlling terminal，如 /dev/tty）貼上 OAuth 授權碼；若在無頭模式（headless runs，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）下則會立刻報錯，不再傻傻等待。就像派助理買限量便當，買不到時他會立刻打電話告知並回報菜單讓你重挑，需要刷卡時也會把刷卡機遞到你面前；若你不在場，他會直接回報失敗，而不是在櫃檯乾等。
body.en: When automating tasks with scripts, the system stops silently changing models or hanging. In print mode (-p, exit-after-printing), if a specified model is missing, the CLI fails fast and lists available options (interactive sessions keep the old fallback-with-warning behavior). Additionally, if piping prompts consumes stdin and login is required, you can paste the OAuth authorization code directly into the controlling terminal (/dev/tty). Truly headless runs fail fast instead of blocking. Like sending an assistant to buy a lunch box — they call you immediately with the menu if it is sold out, and hand you the card reader if payment is needed; if you aren't there, they return instead of waiting forever.

title.zh-TW: 捷徑自動更新不覆蓋，指令檢查不再大驚小怪
title.en: Keybindings stay updated automatically, and nested commands respect allowlists

body.zh-TW: 自訂快捷鍵能隨著系統升級自動更新，指令安全檢查也更聰明了。當系統加入新的預設快捷鍵時，它會自動補上新值，同時完整保留你修改過的按鍵配置（user overrides）。另外，當你輸入包著另一層指令的巢狀指令替換（nested command substitutions，如在 echo 裡包著 git 查詢）時，只要這兩個指令都在允許清單（allowlist，白名單）裡，系統就會直接放行，不再重複計算層數（double-counting）而跳出提示詢問。就像遊戲更新後會自動加上新技能按鍵，且不影響你改過的自訂鍵；也像機場安檢看到包包裡裝著已過安檢的隨身包，不會再叫你拆開檢查一次。
body.en: Custom shortcuts now upgrade automatically, and command security checks are smarter. When the system adds new default keybindings, it injects them while preserving your custom configurations (user overrides). Also, when you write nested command substitutions (like echo wrapping a git query), the system runs them without interruption as long as both commands are on your allowlist. It no longer double-counts the nested layers to prompt for permission. Like updating a game — new ultimate keybindings are added without wiping out your custom jump button; and airport security seeing a pre-screened bag inside another pre-screened bag no longer forces you to unpack it again.

title.zh-TW: 代理分身狀態更精準，MCP 工具不留殘局
title.en: Subagents report accurate states, and MCP tools stop leaking memory

body.zh-TW: 當你叫出多個代理幫忙或掛載外部工具時，進度追蹤更精準，系統也更乾淨。多個代理分身（subagents，平行處理任務的 AI 助手）同時工作時，以前會因資料競爭（data race，搶改同一筆資料）和違反寫入時複製（copy-on-write violation）導致狀態錯亂；現在修改狀態前會先複製紀錄，不再互踩。此外，載入 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具時，以前在獨立模式下會找不到路徑且殘留背景程序（subprocesses）；現在能正確定位並在關閉時清乾淨。就像請裝潢工班，以前搶簽同一張表導致塗改混亂，現在每人發一張表；離開時也一定帶走所有工具，不留電線垃圾。
body.en: Task progress is fully accurate and the system cleans up properly when you run agent teams or load external tools. When multiple subagents (AI helpers running in parallel) work together, the system used to suffer from a data race and copy-on-write violation, corrupting step counts; they now clone records before updating to avoid collisions. Furthermore, when loading MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools, the manager previously failed to resolve paths in standalone mode and leaked background subprocesses; it now locates paths perfectly and sweeps up processes on exit. Like hiring a crew — they used to fight over one sign-in sheet but now get individual clipboards, and clean up all their tools on departure.

items.original:
Fixed mcp manager failing to resolve tool schema paths in standalone mode and leaking MCP server subprocesses after shutdown, which previously caused panics and cleanup failures for custom agents loading MCP tools.
Fixed a data race and copy-on-write violation when updating subagent states by cloning their stats before in-place mutation, preventing corrupted step counts and status for parallel subagents.

entries: Added the `--agent` flag and `agent/agents` subcommand, allowing users to select a custom agent at launch and list available agents.

Added in-file keyword search (`/`) and jump navigation (`n/N`) to the artifact detail viewer, allowing users to find and cycle through matches without disrupting terminal escape sequences or image grids.
Fixed print mode (`--print` / `-p`) silently exiting with a success code and empty output when a request failed server-side, now writing the error to stderr and returning a non-zero exit code.
Fixed `agy -p` hanging when run inside a shell script or subprocess by no longer reading stdin when a prompt is provided via a flag.
Fixed a data race on the `/btw` cancellation function.

Added support for displaying nested subagents (grandchild and deeper) and handling tool confirmation requests across all subagent depths by recursively relaying nested subtrajectory updates to the root conversation.
Changed the default mode to respect write_file permissions allowlisted in `settings.json` under `permission.allow`, so pre-approved file writes no longer prompt for review.
Changed the default name for the newly initialized project to `CLI Project` for clearer workspace identification.
Improved the session exit output by placing the resume command on its own line, making it easier to copy and paste in terminals and tools like tmux.

Fixed interactive `/diff` viewer defects in Jujutsu (jj) workspaces by correctly prioritizing `.jj` over `.git` in colocated repos, fixing commit hash regex boundaries, and correctly highlighting active `@` graph nodes.
Fixed workspace-local hooks defined in `<workspace>/.agents/hooks.json` not loading after trusting a folder by reloading hooks whenever workspaces change.
Fixed misaligned markdown tables containing file links in chat output.

title.zh-TW: 預設改成「寫檔前先給你過目」：逐行看差異、想留哪段自己挑
title.en: New default: Antigravity pauses before writing files and shows a line-level diff

body.zh-TW: Antigravity 動你的檔案之前，現在預設會先停下來給你過目。新的 request-review 模式（顧名思義「請求審核」——動你的檔案前先請你過目）在每次寫檔前攤開逐行差異預覽（diff preview，把改前改後逐行並排、標紅標綠的對照畫面，按 f 開啟），你可以整批接受，也可以一段留一段丟；連新建檔案都有專屬的「Create file」預覽，讓你先看內容再點頭。就像裁縫改衣服前先讓你試穿別上珠針的版本，滿意哪段留哪段，而不是改完才給你看成品。
body.en: Before Antigravity touches your files, it now pauses by default and shows its work. The new request-review mode spreads out a line-level diff preview before every write (a view marking removals red and additions green line by line, opened with f), letting you accept the whole batch or keep some chunks and toss others; even brand-new files get their own "Create file" preview so you approve the content first. Like a tailor pinning the alterations and letting you try them on before sewing, instead of showing you the finished jacket.

items.original: Added `request-review` (default) mode as the default execution behavior: automatically pauses before file write operations to display an interactive, line-level diff preview (`f` shortcut) where users can review, accept, or reject individual code modifications before they are saved to disk. Added a dedicated "Create file" confirmation preview for new file creations (`write_to_file` without overwrite): renders new content as an addition-only diff preview. (1.1.0)

title.zh-TW: shift+tab 循環三種執行模式，/plan 取代 /planning
title.en: Cycle execution modes with shift+tab; /plan replaces /planning

body.zh-TW: 執行模式切換正式開放：按 shift+tab 就能在 default（每次寫檔先問）、accept-edits（放行編輯）、plan（只規劃不動手）三檔之間循環。指令也整併了——/plan 取代舊的 /planning、/fast 直接移除，切換方式收斂成一套，不再多頭馬車。就像檯燈從三顆分開的開關變成一顆旋鈕，轉一下換一檔。
body.en: Execution-mode switching is now public: shift+tab cycles through default (ask before each write), accept-edits (edits sail through), and plan (plan only, hands off). Commands got consolidated too — /plan replaces the old /planning and /fast is removed, folding mode switching into one coherent set. Like a lamp trading three scattered switches for a single knob you click through.

items.original: Agent execution mode cycling is now publicly available: `default` -> `accept-edits` -> `plan`. Added `/plan` mode to replace legacy `/planning`, and removed `/fast` slash commands: consolidated and simplified execution mode switching around `shift+tab` mode cycling and the `/plan` mode prefix. (1.1.0)

title.zh-TW: 預設模式進 /settings 面板，改完立刻生效
title.en: Set your default execution mode right in /settings

body.zh-TW: 想固定用某個執行模式，現在到 /settings 面板挑 Agent Mode 就好，改完即時生效，不用再手動編輯 settings.json（設定檔）、也不用每次啟動都掛 --mode 參數。就像冷氣終於有了遙控器上的「預設模式」鈕，不必每次開機都爬去主機上按。
body.en: To make one execution mode your default, just pick Agent Mode in the /settings panel — it takes effect immediately, with no more hand-editing settings.json (the config file) and no more passing --mode at every launch. Like an air conditioner finally getting a "default mode" button on the remote, so you stop climbing up to the unit each time.

items.original: Added an `Agent Mode` option to the `/settings` panel so users can set and persist a default execution mode (`default`, `accept-edits`, `plan`) without manually editing `settings.json` or passing `--mode` on startup, with real-time synchronization so changes take effect immediately. (1.1.0)

title.zh-TW: 啟動就能指定要用哪個自訂代理
title.en: Pick a custom agent right at launch with --agent

body.zh-TW: 啟動時就能指定要用哪個自訂代理（custom agent，你事先寫好個性與專長的分身）：掛上 --agent 旗標直接點名，agent／agents 子指令還能列出手上有哪些分身可挑。以前得先進門再換人，現在像叫車 App 直接指定司機，上車前就選好。
body.en: You can now pick a custom agent (a persona you've pre-written with its own skills and style) right at launch: name it with the --agent flag, and the agent/agents subcommands list which personas you have. You used to have to walk in first and swap afterwards; now it's like a ride-hailing app that lets you choose the driver before getting in.

items.original: Added the `--agent` flag and `agent/agents` subcommand, allowing users to select a custom agent at launch and list available agents. (1.1.1)

title.zh-TW: 成果檢視器能按 / 搜尋、n/N 跳轉了
title.en: Search inside artifacts with / and hop between matches with n/N

body.zh-TW: 在成果檢視器（artifact viewer，看代理產出的檔案或報告的畫面）裡按 / 就能就地搜尋關鍵字，n 跳下一個、N 跳上一個，長報告不用再用眼睛慢慢掃。就像看紙本說明書終於改成看 PDF，Ctrl+F 一按直達你要的那行。
body.en: In the artifact viewer (the screen for reading files and reports an agent produced), press / to search for a keyword in place, then n and N to hop between matches — no more eyeball-scanning long reports. Like trading a paper manual for a PDF where one Ctrl+F jumps straight to the line you need.

items.original: Added in-file keyword search (`/`) and jump navigation (`n/N`) to the artifact detail viewer, allowing users to find and cycle through matches without disrupting terminal escape sequences or image grids. (1.1.1)

title.zh-TW: 腳本派工救星：-p 失敗會老實報錯，也不再卡住不動
title.en: Script users rejoice: -p now reports failures honestly and never hangs

body.zh-TW: 用腳本呼叫 agy 的人這條最有感：print 模式（--print／-p，不開介面、印完答案就走的無頭用法）以前伺服器端失敗時會裝沒事——回傳成功代碼、輸出空白，害你的腳本以為任務完成了；現在錯誤會寫進 stderr（標準錯誤輸出，專門裝錯誤訊息的通道）並回傳非零代碼。另外在 shell 腳本或子程序裡跑 agy -p 會卡住等輸入的毛病也修了。就像外送員以前送失敗會默默把空袋子掛你門口，現在會確實打電話告訴你「餐沒送到」。
body.en: If you call agy from scripts, this is your fix: print mode (--print / -p, the headless usage that prints an answer and exits) used to play innocent when a request failed server-side — exiting with a success code and empty output, so your script believed the job was done; failures now go to stderr (the standard error stream, the channel reserved for error messages) with a non-zero exit code. The bug where agy -p hung waiting for input inside shell scripts and subprocesses is fixed too. Like a delivery courier who used to silently hang an empty bag on your door after a failed run — now they actually call to say the food didn't make it.

items.original: Fixed print mode (`--print` / `-p`) silently exiting with a success code and empty output when a request failed server-side, now writing the error to stderr and returning a non-zero exit code. Fixed `agy -p` hanging when run inside a shell script or subprocess by no longer reading stdin when a prompt is provided via a flag. (1.1.1)

title.zh-TW: 放行過的寫檔不再重複問
title.en: Pre-approved file writes skip the review prompt

body.zh-TW: 你在 settings.json 的 permission.allow 允許清單（事先放行的白名單）裡核准過的寫檔動作，預設模式現在會直接放行，不再每次都跳審查。就像機場的常客快速通關——身家早就查核過的人，不必每趟都重新排安檢。
body.en: File writes you've already allowlisted under permission.allow in settings.json (the pre-approved whitelist) now sail through in default mode instead of prompting for review every time. Like an airport trusted-traveler lane — once you've been vetted, you don't re-queue for screening on every trip.

items.original: Changed the default mode to respect write_file permissions allowlisted in `settings.json` under `permission.allow`, so pre-approved file writes no longer prompt for review. (1.1.1)

title.zh-TW: 介面細節總打磨：差異預覽、快捷鍵提示、表格對齊都變順眼
title.en: A round of UI polish: diff previews, keybinding hints, and table alignment

body.zh-TW: 這輪順手把一圈介面細節磨亮了：檔案編輯的差異預覽補上前後文和分段線更好讀；各面板頁尾的快捷鍵提示會尊重你自訂的鍵位、不再寫死；/resume 選單裡重新命名對話的輸入框不再把長標題吃掉；聊天輸出裡帶檔案連結的 Markdown 表格也不再歪掉。像車子進廠保養——沒換引擎，但每個按鈕都變順手了。
body.en: A lap of interface polish landed this round: file-edit diff previews gain context lines and section separators for easier reading; footer keybinding hints across panels now respect your customized keys instead of showing hardcoded ones; the rename box in the /resume picker stops swallowing long titles; and Markdown tables with file links in chat output stop skewing. Like a car service visit — same engine, but every knob feels smoother.

items.original: Improved file-edit diff preview rendering: computed accurate line-level diffs with context lines (3 lines) and hunk separators. Improved UI footer keybinding hints across all panels by replacing hardcoded hint strings with centralized layout helpers that dynamically respect customized keybinding configurations. Improved the multiline conversation rename view in the `/resume` picker. Fixed misaligned markdown tables containing file links in chat output. (1.1.0–1.1.1)

title.zh-TW: 預設改檔前先讓你看差異，還能直接用面板切換代理模式
title.en: Previews diffs before editing files by default, and lets you cycle agent modes directly from the panel

body.zh-TW: 改檔前你會先看到差異，可決定是否接受。，會預設先暫停並清楚秀出修改前後的差異。以前程式可能不作聲就把檔案改了，現在它會跳出精細到每一行的差異預覽（diff preview），讓你能先檢查並決定要不要接受；如果是建立新檔案，也會有專屬的預覽畫面，而且如果你在看差異時留了註解還沒送出就想關掉，系統也會貼心提醒你。你也不用再為了切換這些執行模式（像是不問就直接改的 accept-edits 或只規劃的 plan）而去改設定檔或加啟動參數，現在按 shift+tab 就能直接輪替切換，或到 /settings 面板裡用「代理模式」選項點一下就立刻生效。舊版的 /planning 與 /fast 快捷指令也一併整併成更簡潔的 /plan。就像去剪頭髮，以前理髮師可能聽完就直接動刀，現在他預設會先拿鏡子比劃給你看要剪哪裡，你點頭了他才剪，而且你想換成「不廢話直接剪」模式，只要在座位旁的面板點一下就行。
body.en: Before writing or modifying files, the system now defaults to pausing and clearly showing the differences. Previously, the program might silently change files; now, it pops up an interactive line-level diff preview so you can review and decide whether to accept the edits. New file creations also get their own dedicated preview, and if you try to close the diff view with unsent comments, the system will politely warn you. You also no longer need to edit config files or pass startup arguments to switch execution modes (like accept-edits for direct writing or plan for just planning) — you can now cycle through them directly by pressing shift+tab, or instantly apply them via the Agent Mode option in the /settings panel. The old /planning and /fast slash commands have also been consolidated into a cleaner /plan. Like getting a haircut: the barber used to just start snipping right after you spoke, but now they default to holding up a mirror and pointing out exactly what they're going to cut before you nod, and if you want to switch to a "just cut it" mode, you just tap a button next to your chair.

items.original:
Agent execution mode cycling is now publicly available: `default` -> `accept-edits` -> `plan`)
Added `request-review` (default) mode as the default execution behavior: automatically pauses before file write operations to display an interactive, line-level diff preview (`f` shortcut) where users can review, accept, or reject individual code modifications before they are saved to disk.
Added an `Agent Mode` option to the `/settings` panel so users can set and persist a default execution mode (`default`, `accept-edits`, `plan`) without manually editing `settings.json` or passing `--mode` on startup, with real-time synchronization so changes take effect immediately.
Added a dedicated `"Create file"` confirmation preview for new file creations (`write_to_file` without overwrite): renders new content as an addition-only diff preview.
Added `/plan` mode to replace legacy `/planning`, and removed `/fast` slash commands: consolidated and simplified execution mode switching around `shift+tab` mode cycling and the `/plan` mode prefix
Improved file-edit diff preview rendering: computed accurate line-level diffs with context lines (`3` lines) and hunk separators, capped inline preview height with truncation hints, and added a comment confirmation prompt when exiting the diff view with unsent comments.

title.zh-TW: 介面排版更聰明，快捷鍵提示與時間顯示不再錯亂
title.en: Smarter UI layouts, with accurate keybinding hints and correctly localized timestamps

body.zh-TW: 你在各個面板看任務或改名時，畫面變得更整齊，提示也不會再牛頭不對馬嘴了。以前底部的快捷鍵提示是寫死的，就算你自己改了快捷鍵設定檔（keybindings.json），畫面上還是教你舊的按法；現在它會乖乖照你改的顯示。在 /resume 裡幫對話改名時，輸入框會自動調整寬度，旁邊的資訊也會好好靠右對齊，不會因為你打字就讓整個畫面亂跳。全螢幕面板（像設定或更新日誌）裡也不會再跑出多餘的「按 ? 看快捷鍵」或「按 Esc 取消」來干擾視線。另外，背景任務的時間戳（timestamp）也不會再傻傻顯示格林威治標準時間（UTC），現在都會自動換算成你所在地的時間。就像看展覽，以前每個展區門口的導覽圖都是舊版的，有些地方還貼著不相干的「往上走」箭頭，現在所有告示牌都跟你手上的最新地圖同步，而且營業時間也終於換成你熟悉的本地時間了。
body.en: The interface layout is now much tidier when you view tasks or rename conversations, and the hints no longer confidently give you the wrong instructions. Previously, the keybinding hints at the bottom of the screen were hardcoded; even if you modified your custom keybindings file (keybindings.json), the screen would still display the default keys. Now, it accurately reflects your custom bindings. When renaming a conversation in the /resume picker, the input box dynamically adjusts its width, and metadata columns properly align to the right, preventing the screen from jumping around while you type. Full-screen panels (like settings or changelogs) will also stop flashing redundant "Press ? for shortcuts" or "Esc to cancel" messages that clutter the view. Moreover, background task timestamps no longer blindly display UTC; they now correctly convert to your local timezone. Like walking through a museum: the old entrance maps used to be outdated and plastered with irrelevant "Walk Up" arrows, but now every signpost perfectly syncs with the latest map in your hand, and the operating hours are finally shown in your local time.

items.original:
Improved UI footer keybinding hints across all panels (such as `/tasks`, `/agents`, `/permissions`, and `/mcp`) by replacing hardcoded hint strings with centralized layout helpers that dynamically respect customized global and local keybinding configurations (`keybindings.json`).
Improved the multiline conversation rename view in the `/resume` picker by dynamically adjusting input box width and padding, and right-aligning metadata columns (`workspace`, `steps`, `time`) on the top line to prevent horizontal scrolling or layout shifts during active renaming.
Fixed statusline shortcut hints (`? for shortcuts`) and redundant escape hints (`Esc to cancel`) erroneously appearing inside full-screen overlay panels (such as `/changelog`, `/artifact`, and `/settings`) by correctly tracking overlay panel states.
Fixed inconsistent timestamp formatting in the `/tasks` panel and task detail views by converting agent-initiated background task timestamps (`time.Time`) from UTC to the local timezone.

title.zh-TW: 修好各種路徑與目錄誤判，建新檔案不再被無辜阻擋
title.en: Fixes path and directory misjudgments, stopping innocent file creations from being blocked

body.zh-TW: 你在自己的工作目錄裡建立或讀取檔案，不會再莫名其妙被系統警告了。以前因為路徑判斷的瑕疵，就算你明明在正確的資料夾裡做事，工具確認對話框還是會誤判並跳出「超出工作目錄外」的警告；現在這個問題修好了。如果你把專案放在名稱有加點的前置目錄（像是 .parent_dir/project），以前系統會因為過濾規則太廣而啟動失敗，現在也懂得只管目錄裡面的事而不會亂擋。建立新代理時，面板上的路徑終於指向正確的設定檔總目錄（~/.gemini/config/），標題也不會再把應該是 agent.md 的附檔名錯寫成 agent.json。就像進自己公司辦公室，以前警衛會因為你走過的路名叫「.暗巷」就不准你上班，或者明明在自己座位上辦公卻被警告「擅闖禁區」，現在警衛終於認得你而且認得公司的範圍了。
body.en: Creating or reading files inside your own workspace will no longer inexplicably trigger system warnings. Previously, due to a flaw in path resolution, the tool confirmation dialog would misjudge perfectly valid in-workspace actions and throw an "outside workspace" warning; this is now fixed. If you kept your project inside a parent directory that started with a dot (like .parent_dir/project), the system used to fail to start because its exclusion filters were overly broad; it now correctly limits its checks to paths within the workspace. When creating a new agent, the panel now points to the correct global config directory (~/.gemini/config/), and the header no longer mistakenly lists the extension as agent.json when it should be agent.md. Like entering your own office building: the security guard used to ban you from working just because the road you took was named ".dark_alley", or warned you for "trespassing" while you were sitting at your own desk; now the guard finally recognizes you and knows the actual boundaries of the company.

items.original:
Fixed the tool confirmation dialog to accurately check normalized file URIs against active workspace directories, resolving an issue where valid in-workspace file creations and reads were incorrectly flagged with an `"Reason: outside workspace"` warning.
Fixed workspace initialization failures when launching the CLI inside dot-prefixed directories (such as  .parent_dir/project ) by scoping path exclusion filters strictly to relative paths inside the workspace rather than rejecting dot-prefixed ancestor directories.
Fixed the `/agents` panel's `"Create New Agents"` section displaying the wrong global configuration directory (`~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/` instead of `~/.gemini/config/`), ensuring users create global subagents in the location actively scanned during startup discovery.
Fixed the `/agents` view header displaying `agent.json` instead of `agent.md` when creating new subagents.

entries: Improved the `/tasks` detail panel to automatically scroll to the bottom as new background task logs stream in, and default to the latest output when opened while preserving scroll position if scrolled up manually.
Improved model generation resilience by adding automatic client-side retries when encountering transient errors.
Fixed dynamically defined subagents by transitioning definitions from JSON to Markdown format, fixing an issue where dynamically created subagents failed to invoke.
Fixed a crash occurring when executing background tasks or terminal commands that produce empty outputs (such as `sleep`).
Fixed shutdown resource leaks by integrating the shared SQLite summary store for background synchronization and resolving goroutine and database connection leaks on CLI exit.
Fixed a permission manager hook error by safely handling empty decision strings returned by pre-tool hooks instead of failing with an "unknown pre-tool hook decision" error.

title.zh-TW: 輸入框下方新增狀態列，一眼掌控所有在背景默默工作的助手
title.en: New real-time status bar showing all subagents working in the background

body.zh-TW: 為了讓你隨時掌握背景任務的動向，系統在輸入框正下方設計了全新的互動式狀態列。它可以即時顯示 active subagents（在背景幫你分析程式碼或寫報告的子助理 AI）與 background tasks（丟給電腦在背後慢慢執行的耗時指令，例如跑測試或編譯）的即時動態，讓你在輸入指令時一眼看清背後是誰在忙、有沒有卡住，不需手動打命令查詢。這就像你在辦公室裝了透明玻璃，抬頭就能看到小助手們是不是在賣力打字、測試軟體，不用每隔五分鐘就跑去敲門問進度。
body.en: A new interactive status line has been added directly under the input prompt. It reports on active subagents (helper AIs spawned in the background to analyze code or write docs) and background tasks (long-running processes like code compilation or test suites running behind the scenes) in real-time, allowing you to see if anything is stuck without typing queries. It's like replacing solid walls with glass windows in an office; now you can see if your assistants are typing away, without having to knock on their doors every five minutes.

items.original: Introduced a new interactive status indicator below the input box that displays active subagents and background tasks in real-time.

title.zh-TW: 背景任務面板會隨日誌更新自動下捲，省去你一直手動滾畫面的麻煩
title.en: Task detail panel now auto-scrolls down to show live logs as they write

body.zh-TW: 為了省去你反覆手動滾動日誌畫面的時間，`/tasks` 詳情視窗現在會配合日誌流更新自動下捲。每當新的背景任務 log（程式執行時印出的詳細過程與輸出文字）吐出時，視窗會自動捲到底部呈現最新一行；若你手動向上滾動檢視舊內容，自動下捲就會貼心暫停，絕不強行拉回底部打斷閱讀。這就像你用手機通訊軟體聊天，畫面會隨著對方的回信自動往下推進、顯示最新訊息；但當你想往上翻舊對話時，畫面也不會調皮地一直跳回最底下。
body.en: To save you from constantly fighting the scrollbar to see progress, the `/tasks` detail panel now auto-scrolls down in sync with log streams. As new background task log output (log, text streams outputted by programs as they run to describe their progress) arrives, the panel scrolls to show the latest lines, but pauses if you manually scroll up to inspect earlier entries. It's like typing in a chat app where the view scrolls to keep up with new incoming messages, but stays put if you scroll up to reread what was said earlier.

items.original: Improved the /tasks detail panel to automatically scroll to the bottom as new background task logs stream in, and default to the latest output when opened while preserving scroll position if scrolled up manually.

title.zh-TW: Windows 貼上圖片新增 Alt+V 鍵，不再被終端機快捷鍵擋下來
title.en: Added Alt+V on Windows as an alternative shortcut to paste clipboard images

body.zh-TW: 為了讓 Windows 使用者能順暢貼上剪貼簿中的截圖，系統新增了專屬貼上快捷鍵。如果你的 `Ctrl+V` 被終端機軟體（如命令提示字元或 PowerShell 視窗）攔截而無法貼上，現在可以直接改按 `Alt+V`，即可順利將圖片或文字貼進輸入框，不再因鍵位衝突而卡關。這就像是大樓的旋轉門（Ctrl+V）因為安全設定把你的大件行李（圖片）卡在門外，現在保全在旁邊幫你開了一扇專屬的側門（Alt+V），讓你提著行李也能輕鬆通過。
body.en: App features an alternative paste hotkey. If your standard `Ctrl+V` is hijacked by your terminal emulator (the shell window programs like CMD or PowerShell), you can press `Alt+V` instead to insert clipboard images or text directly, avoiding shortcut conflicts. It's like a revolving entrance door (Ctrl+V) that keeps locking because your large luggage (images) gets stuck; now security has opened a side door (Alt+V) so you can carry your luggage straight in.

items.original: Added alt+v as an alternative paste shortcut on Windows to resolve issues where ctrl+v is intercepted by the terminal emulator, enabling reliable image pasting.

title.zh-TW: 在看 AI 檔案時按 Ctrl+G 就能用你最愛的編輯器直接打開修改
title.en: Press Ctrl+G on an artifact to edit it directly in your favorite editor

body.zh-TW: 為了讓你能直接使用最習慣的開發工具修改 AI 產出的內容，現在在成果畫面可以直接呼叫外部編輯器。當你在檢視 AI 寫好的 artifacts（AI 產出的程式碼或完整文件檔案）時，按一下 `Ctrl+G` 就會以你本機設定的 `$EDITOR`（你的預設文字編輯器，比如 VS Code 或 Vim）開啟該檔案；若當前有未送出的草稿備註，系統也會貼心詢問是否保留。這就像你原本用公用電腦看文件，現在按一下按鈕，這份文件就直接拷貝一份用你自己的筆記本電腦打開，還順便幫你帶上剛剛寫了一半的草稿紙。
body.en: You can now open files directly in your preferred editor. While viewing generated artifacts (artifacts, documents or files of code generated by the AI for you to read), pressing `Ctrl+G` opens the file in your configured `$EDITOR` (your default text editor, such as VS Code, Vim, or Notepad), checking to save any unsent comment drafts first. It's like viewing a document on a library tablet and pressing a button that instantly transfers the file to your personal laptop, along with the half-written sticky notes you had placed on it.

items.original: Added ctrl+g on the artifact view to open $EDITOR, with a warning confirmation prompt before opening the editor in the artifact detail view if there are unsent comments.

title.zh-TW: 遇到網路斷線或伺服器忙碌時，系統會自動在背後重試、寫程式不中斷
title.en: Auto-retry on network glitches or busy servers, keeping your code sessions flowing

body.zh-TW: 為了防止網路波動打斷你的思考，系統提升了模型生成時的容錯能力。當 AI 回答遇到 transient errors（因為網路不穩暫時斷線，或是雲端伺服器瞬間過載造成的暫時性錯誤）時，系統會自動在背後嘗試重新連線並接續發送，不會像以前一樣直接噴錯中斷，逼你把指令重新打一遍。這就像你打電話給客服時突然訊號不好斷線，系統在背景幫你自動重撥，接通了直接讓你跟原本的客服人員繼續聊，不用重新撥號排隊。
body.en: Response generation is now more resilient. When the AI model runs into transient errors (transient errors, temporary failures caused by unstable Wi-Fi disconnects or brief cloud server overloads), the app automatically handles client-side retries behind the scenes, rather than aborting and making you resubmit your prompt. It's like being on a support call when your signal drops; instead of hanging up and making you dial and queue again, the phone system automatically redials in the background and reconnects you to the same agent.

items.original: Improved model generation resilience by adding automatic client-side retries when encountering transient errors.

title.zh-TW: 跑那種完全沒印出字的背景指令（如 sleep）時，系統不會再崩潰了
title.en: Executing background commands with zero text output (like sleep) no longer crashes the app

body.zh-TW: 為了能安心執行所有類型的終端指令，背景任務現在能正確處理完全沒有內容的輸出。以前當你執行的 background tasks（丟到背景悄悄執行的任務，例如延遲幾秒的 `sleep` 指令）沒有印出任何文字時，系統會因為讀到 empty outputs（完全沒有任何文字的空輸出結果）而觸發崩潰錯誤；現在已修妥此問題，即使指令靜悄悄地執行完畢也絕不當機。這就像你以前叫保鏢去辦事，如果他沒拿回任何文件，你就認定他出了意外而直接抓狂；現在你懂了「沒拿回文件也是一種正常辦完的結果」，大家相安無事。
body.en: Background executors now handle silent processes properly. Previously, if background tasks (tasks sent to run silently in the background, like a `sleep` command that pauses for a few seconds) yielded empty outputs (empty outputs, console command outputs containing absolutely no text), the internal reader panicked and crashed; this is now fixed so silent finishes close cleanly. It's like hiring a messenger and panicking that he was kidnapped because he came back with no letters; now you understand that returning empty-handed is a perfectly normal result.

items.original: Fixed a crash occurring when executing background tasks or terminal commands that produce empty outputs (such as sleep).

title.zh-TW: 修正臨時建立的小助手助理因為格式錯誤而無法被叫醒的 bug
title.en: Fixed custom, dynamically created helper agents failing to wake up due to format bugs

body.zh-TW: 為了讓你能量身訂做特殊助手，臨時建立客製化助理的流程已被完全修復。以前你使用 `define_subagent` 臨時在系統中產生一個具有特定指示與工具權限的 dynamically defined subagents（你臨時為特殊工作量身設定、具有獨特指示與工具權限的小助手）時，會因為內部以脆弱的 JSON 格式傳遞而導致無法被順利喚醒；現在系統已全面改用 Markdown 格式，你的客製化助理可以穩定就位、隨喚隨到。這就像你原本用繁雜晦澀的手寫表格（JSON）去申請臨時雇員，表格填錯一個空格就被駁回；現在改成用一般白話紙條（Markdown）交代，助理一看就懂，馬上就能開工。
body.en: Custom agent creations are now fully functional. Spawning custom helper agents on the fly via define_subagent (dynamically defined subagents, custom AIs created on the fly with specialized prompts and tool permissions for unique tasks) used to fail due to fragile JSON format checks; the app now maps these in Markdown, allowing custom helpers to wake up and run immediately. It's like filling out a complex, poorly designed form (JSON) to hire a temp worker where one wrong checkmark rejects the request; now you just write a simple sticky note (Markdown) that they read and start working from immediately.

items.original: Fixed dynamically defined subagents failing to invoke by transitioning definitions from JSON to Markdown format.

entries: Introduced a new interactive status indicator below the input box that displays active subagents and background tasks in real-time, making it easy to monitor and navigate parallel workflows at a glance.

Added `ctrl+g` on the artifact view to open $EDITOR. Also added a warning confirmation prompt before opening the editor in the artifact detail view if there are unsent comments, and ensured these comments are preserved upon reload if the artifact content was not modified.
Added `alt+v` as an alternative paste shortcut on Windows to resolve issues where ctrl+v is intercepted by the terminal emulator, enabling reliable image pasting.
Improved the `/permissions` panel to dynamically reload configurations from disk and prevent accidental overwrites.
Increased the MCP connection timeout to 60 seconds to improve reliability for slow-starting custom MCP servers.
Fixed a bug on Windows where print mode and other non-TUI command outputs were silently discarded when run in non-TTY environments (such as pipes or subprocesses).
Fixed Windows editor fallback to use "edit" or "notepad" when the editor setting is "auto" and no editor is configured, instead of attempting to use "vim".
Fixed the subagent approval TUI to dynamically render user-defined custom keybindings (such as alternative approval keys) instead of showing hardcoded defaults.
Fixed alignment and wrapping issues in the comment editor for multiline comments, ensuring all lines are indented consistently.

title.zh-TW: 即時掌握背景進度，人工編輯產出不再掉註解
title.en: Monitor background progress instantly, and keep comments safe when editing artifacts

body.zh-TW: 現在你的輸入框下方多了個動態進度條，哪些子代理或背景任務正在跑一目了然，隨時可以點過去看。當你看著產出文件（artifact）想自己動手改時，現在按 ctrl+g 就能直接呼叫你的外部編輯器來改；如果你在畫面裡留了註解還沒送出就跑去開編輯器，系統也會跳出警告提醒你，只要你沒改掉原本的內容，退回來後註解都還在。寫多行註解時，版面也會好好對齊，不會縮排跑掉。就像餐廳結帳櫃檯旁邊多了一個螢幕顯示廚房哪幾道菜正在做，而且你想自己進廚房加料前，服務生會提醒你「桌上的意見卡還沒寫完喔」，而且不會因為你離開一下就把意見卡收走。
body.en: There is now a dynamic status indicator below your input box, showing you exactly which subagents and background tasks are running at a glance, and you can click to navigate to them anytime. When you are viewing an artifact and want to edit it yourself, you can now press ctrl+g to instantly open your external editor; if you have unsent comments on the screen and try to open the editor, the system will pop up a warning, and as long as you don't modify the original content, those comments will still be there when you return. When writing multi-line comments, the layout will also align properly without messing up the indentation. Like a restaurant checkout counter that added a screen showing exactly which dishes the kitchen is cooking, and before you walk into the kitchen to add ingredients yourself, the waiter politely warns you that you haven't finished filling out the feedback card on the table — and ensures the card isn't thrown away while you're gone.

items.original:

Added `ctrl+g` on the artifact view to open $EDITOR. Also added a warning confirmation prompt before opening the editor in the artifact detail view if there are unsent comments, and ensured these comments are preserved upon reload if the artifact content was not modified.

title.zh-TW: 解決 Windows 貼上無效與文字編輯器當機問題
title.en: Fixes ignored pastes and editor crashes on Windows

body.zh-TW: 用 Windows 的人，現在可以直接按 alt+v 貼上圖片了。以前因為作業系統的終端機軟體會攔截 ctrl+v，導致貼上功能時常沒反應；現在多了個備用快捷鍵解決這問題。如果你在設定裡把文字編輯器設為「自動」但又沒裝特別的編輯器，以前系統會傻傻地去呼叫不存在的 vim 然後當掉，現在它懂得乖乖去叫預設的記事本了。此外，當你在不跳視窗的純文字模式下執行指令（例如用管線 pipe 把輸出傳給別的程式），系統也不會再把印出的字默默吃掉了。就像在國外買東西，以前用信用卡如果刷不過就沒轍，現在多提供你一個手機支付的選項，而且店員也終於認得你當地的國民身分證了。
body.en: Windows users can now reliably paste images by pressing alt+v. Previously, the operating system's terminal emulator would often intercept ctrl+v, causing the paste function to mysteriously do nothing; this alternative shortcut solves the problem. If you set your text editor to "auto" but hadn't installed any fancy editors, the system used to blindly call a non-existent vim and crash; it now smartly defaults to Notepad. Furthermore, when you run commands in text-only environments (like piping the output to another program), the system will no longer silently swallow the printed text. Like shopping abroad: if your credit card got declined, you used to be out of luck, but now they offer a mobile payment alternative, and the clerk finally knows how to read your local ID card.

items.original:
Added `alt+v` as an alternative paste shortcut on Windows to resolve issues where ctrl+v is intercepted by the terminal emulator, enabling reliable image pasting.
Fixed a bug on Windows where print mode and other non-TUI command outputs were silently discarded when run in non-TTY environments (such as pipes or subprocesses).
Fixed Windows editor fallback to use "edit" or "notepad" when the editor setting is "auto" and no editor is configured, instead of attempting to use "vim".

title.zh-TW: MCP 連線更寬容，設定檔能隨時重整不蓋台
title.en: More forgiving MCP connections and dynamic permission reloads without overwrites

body.zh-TW: 連慢啟動的 MCP 伺服器時，你現在可多等 60 秒。（讓 AI 接上外部工具的協定）時，會耐心等足 60 秒才放棄，不再因為對方動作慢就連線失敗。當你在 /permissions 權限面板看設定時，系統也會聰明地從硬碟重新讀取最新的狀態，避免你一不小心把別處剛改好的設定又蓋過去了。在審核子代理的畫面裡，畫面上提示的按鍵也會確實顯示你自己改過的快捷鍵，不會再寫死成預設按鍵騙你。就像你去辦事處抽號碼牌，以前櫃檯只等三秒沒人就跳號，現在會等你一分鐘；而且辦事員的螢幕也會隨時跟總局的資料庫同步，不會因為不同步就讓你填的資料被洗掉。
body.en: When connecting to slow-starting custom MCP servers (the protocol that connects AI to external tools), the system will now patiently wait up to 60 seconds before giving up, no longer dropping the connection just because the server took a bit to warm up. While viewing the /permissions panel, the system now smartly reloads the latest state from the disk, preventing you from accidentally overwriting settings you just updated elsewhere. Also, in the subagent approval screen, the key hints now accurately reflect any custom keybindings you set, rather than lying to you with hardcoded defaults. Like drawing a number at a government office: the clerk used to call your number and instantly skip you if you didn't run to the desk in three seconds, but now they wait a whole minute; additionally, the clerk's computer perfectly syncs with the main database so your freshly submitted forms don't get accidentally overwritten.

items.original:
Improved the `/permissions` panel to dynamically reload configurations from disk and prevent accidental overwrites.
Increased the MCP connection timeout to 60 seconds to improve reliability for slow-starting custom MCP servers.
Fixed the subagent approval TUI to dynamically render user-defined custom keybindings (such as alternative approval keys) instead of showing hardcoded defaults.

entries: Allowed image pasting from the clipboard in local tmux sessions.
Removed the max limit for the `/goal` command, allowing goals to run indefinitely until completed or cancelled.
Enabled "always proceeds" mode for subagents to auto approve artifacts, preventing them from hanging when the parent is blocked.
Fixed plugin import logic to copy the entire plugin directory, preventing it from stripping non-skill directories (like `shared/`).
Fixed an MCP configuration path mismatch in the CLI and permission manager to ensure reliable custom MCP server loading.
Fixed a TUI layout race condition caused by stale input state in the conversation model.
Fixed a bug where the inline viewport was not properly reset after a conversation rewind.

title.zh-TW: 在 tmux 終端機分頁裡也能直接貼上剪貼簿的圖片了
title.en: Pasting clipboard images now works inside tmux panes too

body.zh-TW: tmux（一種能在終端機裡開多個分頁、背景常駐執行的工具）使用者以前在裡面用 Antigravity 時沒辦法直接貼上剪貼簿裡的圖片，得繞路用別的方式才能把截圖塞進對話。現在可以直接貼上了，跟在一般終端機裡操作一樣方便。
body.en: Tmux (a tool that lets you run multiple panes inside a terminal session that keeps running in the background) users previously couldn't paste clipboard images directly while using Antigravity inside it, and had to work around it some other way to get a screenshot into the chat. Now you can just paste it, exactly as easily as in a regular terminal.

items.original: Allowed image pasting from the clipboard in local tmux sessions.

title.zh-TW: `/goal` 長任務不再被強制中斷，AI 可以一路做到完成為止
title.en: `/goal` no longer cuts long tasks short — the AI can run until it's actually done

body.zh-TW: `/goal`（設定一個長期目標、讓 AI 自己規劃步驟去達成的指令）以前有個跑多久就會被系統強制喊停的上限，就算任務還沒做完也得停下來。現在拿掉了這個上限，AI 會一直做下去，直到任務真正完成或你自己取消為止，不會被系統半路打斷。
body.en: `/goal` (the command that sets a long-term objective and lets the AI plan its own steps to get there) used to be capped at a maximum runtime — the system would force it to stop even if the task wasn't done. That cap is now removed: the AI keeps working until the task is genuinely complete or you cancel it yourself, with no mid-task interruption from the system.

items.original: Removed the max limit for the `/goal` command, allowing goals to run indefinitely until completed or cancelled.

title.zh-TW: 自動完成選到技能指令後，現在真的會送出去執行，不會選了卻沒反應
title.en: Picking a skill command from autocomplete now actually runs it, instead of doing nothing

body.zh-TW: 技能（skill，預先包好的一組指令範本，輸入 `/` 開頭呼叫）指令以前如果你是從自動完成（autocomplete，打到一半系統幫你列出建議選項）的清單裡點選的，偶爾會發生輸入框被清空、但指令根本沒送出去執行的怪狀況，等於你選了等於沒選。現在修好了，從清單點選後會確實送出執行。
body.en: Skill (skill, a pre-packaged set of command templates invoked with a leading `/`) commands used to occasionally clear the input box without actually submitting, when you picked them from the autocomplete (autocomplete, the suggestion list that pops up partway through typing) list — selecting it had no effect. Now it's fixed: picking from the list reliably submits and runs.

items.original: Resolved inconsistent behavior where selecting skill-derived slash commands from autocompletion suggestions cleared the input without executing. Autocompleted skill commands are now correctly submitted to the backend.

title.zh-TW: 「永遠允許」的指令規則預設改成「完全比對」，比較不會誤放行危險指令
title.en: "Always Approve" rules now default to exact matching, far less likely to wave through a dangerous lookalike command

body.zh-TW: 「永遠允許」（Always Approve，你設定好以後同類指令不用每次都跳出來問你同意）這種規則以前預設用比對範圍很寬的正規表示式（regex，一種可以模糊比對文字模式的寫法，但也容易不小心放行不該放行的東西）去判斷，現在預設改成「完全照字面比對」，比較不容易誤放行看起來像但其實不一樣的危險指令；如果你真的需要模糊比對的彈性，可以在規則前面加上 `regex:` 自己選擇開啟。這就像門禁系統以前刷「長得很像」的卡就放行，現在改成一定要刷一模一樣的卡才開門，除非你自己特別交代要放寬。
body.en: 'Always Approve' rules (Always Approve, settings that let matching commands skip asking for your consent every time) used to default to matching with loose regular expressions (regex, a pattern-matching syntax that's flexible but can accidentally let through things that look similar but aren't), which now default to strict literal matching instead — much less likely to wave through a dangerous command that merely resembles an approved one. If you really need the flexibility of fuzzy matching, you can opt in by prefixing a rule with `regex:`. It's like an access card reader that used to accept cards that 'looked close enough'; now it requires an exact match unless you specifically tell it to relax.

items.original: Improved command permission security by making "Always Approve" rule matching strict (non-regex) by default, while allowing users to explicitly opt-in to regex matching by prepending rules with `regex:`.

title.zh-TW: 把指令結果存成檔案這種安全動作，現在不會每次都被擋下來要你重新核准
title.en: Safe output-redirection commands no longer get blocked for re-approval every single time

body.zh-TW: 像 `tool > file`（把某個指令的輸出結果導向、存成一個檔案，> 符號叫做重新導向）這種其實很安全的常見寫法，以前因為系統比對規則太嚴格，常常被當成「跟之前核准過的指令不完全一樣」而要你重新核准一次。現在放寬了這類檢查，安全的輸出重新導向指令可以直接套用你之前設定好的允許規則，不用每次都被多問一次。
body.en: Genuinely safe, common patterns like `tool > file` (redirecting a command's output into a file, where `>` is a redirection symbol) used to often get flagged as 'not quite the same' as a previously approved command, forcing you to re-approve every time, because the matching rules were too strict. These checks are now relaxed — safe output-redirection commands can apply your existing approval rules directly, without being asked again every time.

items.original: Improved command permission usability by relaxing redirection checks, allowing safe commands with output redirection (e.g., `tool > file`) to match without requiring strict full-command approval.

title.zh-TW: 終端機裡的連結變成可以直接點，看 diff 也能按 shift+n 往回翻
title.en: Links in the terminal are now clickable, and you can press shift+n to step backward through a diff

body.zh-TW: 支援的終端機現在能把網址顯示成真正可以點擊的連結（OSC8，一種讓終端機文字變成可點擊超連結的技術標準），舊版不支援的終端機則會自動退回成純文字、不會顯示亂碼。另外在統一差異檢視模式（diff review，比對程式碼修改前後差異的畫面）裡新增了 `shift+n` 快捷鍵，可以往回翻看上一段修改，不用只能往前翻。
body.en: Terminals that support it can now render URLs as genuinely clickable links (OSC8, a technical standard for clickable hyperlinks inside terminal text), while older unsupported terminals automatically fall back to plain text instead of garbled output. Also, the unified diff review screen (diff review, the view that compares code before and after a change) now has a `shift+n` shortcut to cycle backward through changes, instead of only being able to move forward.

items.original: Added dynamic OSC8 terminal hyperlink support to render clickable links in supporting terminals, with automatic fallback stripping for backward compatibility. Introduced reverse diff cycling navigation mapped to `shift+n` in unified diff review mode to allow users to easily cycle backwards through diff blocks.

title.zh-TW: 程式碼區塊裡的 Makefile 語法不會再被誤判成數學公式、印出亂碼
title.en: Makefile syntax inside code blocks no longer gets mistaken for math formulas and garbled

body.zh-TW: Antigravity 支援 LaTeX（一種專門用來排版數學公式的標記語法）數學公式渲染，但以前連程式碼區塊裡 Makefile（一種寫建置指令的設定檔語法）的 `$(call ...)` 這類寫法都會被誤判成數學公式語法去解析，結果印出一團亂碼。現在加了一道判斷機制，只在一般文字段落才會嘗試解析數學公式，程式碼區塊裡的內容不會被誤傷。
body.en: Antigravity supports LaTeX (a markup syntax dedicated to typesetting math formulas) math rendering, but it used to misread Makefile (a config syntax for writing build instructions) patterns like `$(call ...)` inside code blocks as math formula syntax, garbling the output. A new state machine now restricts math-formula parsing to plain prose paragraphs only, so code block contents no longer get caught in the crossfire.

items.original: Fixed a rendering bug where Makefile syntax (like `$(call ...)`) inside code blocks was mistakenly parsed and mangled by LaTeX math expansion, by introducing a state machine that restricts expansion to prose segments.

entries: Fixed a bug where the CLI would temporarily render skill commands without their slash prefix during optimistic updates by deferring prefix stripping to the serialization boundary, ensuring the UI always displays exactly what the user typed.
Fixed a redundant CLI exit message by removing the "Resume in the same project" hint line, leaving only the standard resume command to simplify exit output.

Resolved bugs during UI transitions (such as opening subagent details or logging out) by introducing a unified synchronization mechanism that prevents key lockups and ensures overlay panels like the /help view are properly reset.

Improved command permission security by making "Always Approve" rule matching strict (non-regex) by default, while allowing users to explicitly opt-in to regex matching by prepending rules with `regex:`.
Improved command permission usability by relaxing redirection checks, allowing safe commands with output redirection (e.g., `tool > file`) to match without requiring strict full-command approval.
Fixed a bug in the CLI prompt editor where undo and redo history stacks could become desynchronized during rapid mutations by decoupling the history state into a unified, pointer-backed structure.
Fixed a bug where browser-related prompt sections were missing from the agent's prompt registry, ensuring browser-based tasks execute reliably.

title.zh-TW: 指令放行機制更聰明，認得輸出轉向也更安全
title.en: Smarter command approvals: strict matching and redirection awareness

body.zh-TW: 現在「永遠允許執行」的指令名單變得更嚴謹也更聰明了。以前只要指令名字有部分對得上，系統可能就會放行，現在預設改成必須「完全一模一樣」才算數，除非你自己加上 regex: 前綴來指定使用正規表示式（regular expression，一種用符號表示文字特徵的寫法）。同時，它也沒那麼死板了：如果你只是把原本已經允許的指令結果輸出存進檔案（像 `指令 > 檔案` 這樣），系統不會因為你多加了輸出轉向的寫法就把你擋下來。就像大樓警衛，以前只要名牌上有一樣的字就放人，現在預設只認全名，但如果你只是手上多拿了個要存進倉庫的箱子，他也不會故意刁難你。
body.en: The "Always Approve" command list is now both stricter and smarter. Previously, partial name matches might slip through, but now the default requires an exact, full-string match unless you explicitly prepend rules with regex: to use regular expressions (a pattern-matching syntax). At the same time, it's less rigid about minor additions: if you just pipe the output of an already-approved command into a file (like `command > file`), the system will no longer block you simply because you added redirection syntax. Like a building security guard who used to let people in if their badge had any matching words, but now strictly checks the full name — yet won't maliciously stop you just because you're holding a box destined for the warehouse.

items.original:
Improved command permission security by making "Always Approve" rule matching strict (non-regex) by default, while allowing users to explicitly opt-in to regex matching by prepending rules with `regex:`.
Improved command permission usability by relaxing redirection checks, allowing safe commands with output redirection (e.g., `tool > file`) to match without requiring strict full-command approval.

title.zh-TW: 修好畫面切換死當與打字復原失效問題
title.en: Fixes UI transition lockups and editor undo history failures

body.zh-TW: 切換畫面、快速復原不再卡死。現在當你在不同畫面間切換（例如打開子代理詳情或登出）時，鍵盤不會再突然完全沒反應卡死，輔助說明的面板也會正確關閉。如果你在輸入框裡打字太快並頻繁按復原（undo）或重做（redo），歷史紀錄也不會再亂掉。打上帶有斜線的特殊捷徑指令時，送出的瞬間那個斜線也不會因為畫面更新而短暫消失，你打什麼它就顯示什麼。此外，退出程式時也不會再囉嗦地印出兩行重複的提示，清爽多了；而叫代理去瀏覽網頁時，它也不會因為忘記帶上瀏覽器專用的內部提示詞而失敗。就像開車，以前切換排檔時方向盤偶爾會卡死，音響也會短暫消音，現在整台車的操控變得順暢無比。
body.en: A bunch of annoying hiccups that made navigating the terminal feel clunky have been fixed. Now, when transitioning between different views (like opening subagent details or logging out), the keyboard won't suddenly lock up and stop responding, and help overlay panels will close properly. If you type rapidly in the input box and frequently mash undo or redo, your edit history stack won't get hopelessly desynchronized anymore. When you type special slash commands, the slash prefix will no longer flicker and momentarily disappear from the screen right as you hit send; it exactly displays what you typed. Moreover, exiting the program no longer spams redundant reminder lines, making the output much cleaner, and asking agents to browse the web won't randomly fail because it forgot to load the browser-specific internal prompts. Like driving a car: shifting gears used to occasionally lock the steering wheel and briefly mute the radio, but now the entire driving experience handles flawlessly.

items.original:
Resolved bugs during UI transitions (such as opening subagent details or logging out) by introducing a unified synchronization mechanism that prevents key lockups and ensures overlay panels like the /help view are properly reset.
Fixed a bug in the CLI prompt editor where undo and redo history stacks could become desynchronized during rapid mutations by decoupling the history state into a unified, pointer-backed structure.
Fixed a bug where the CLI would temporarily render skill commands without their slash prefix during optimistic updates by deferring prefix stripping to the serialization boundary, ensuring the UI always displays exactly what the user typed.
Fixed a redundant CLI exit message by removing the "Resume in the same project" hint line, leaving only the standard resume command to simplify exit output.
Fixed a bug where browser-related prompt sections were missing from the agent's prompt registry, ensuring browser-based tasks execute reliably.

entries: Added support for `--project` and `--new-project` launch flags to allow users to explicitly set or create projects, and updated the project resolution logic to default regardless of the active workspace.
Added a confirmation prompt when pressing `Esc` in comment mode with unsaved modifications to prevent users from accidentally discarding their work in review views.
Added dynamic OSC8 terminal hyperlink support to render clickable links in supporting terminals, with automatic fallback stripping for backward compatibility.
Introduced reverse diff cycling navigation mapped to `shift+n` in unified diff review mode to allow users to easily cycle backwards through diff blocks.

Improved permission config merging priorities by ensuring project-specific configurations (located in `~/.gemini/config/projects/`) take precedence over global settings in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json`.
Fixed a regression where `ctrl+o` scrollback clearing failed by restoring the use of cached fields rather than shared pointer comparisons for trajectory toggle detection.

Fixed a rendering bug where Makefile syntax (like `$(call ...)`) inside code blocks was mistakenly parsed and mangled by LaTeX math expansion, by introducing a state machine that restricts expansion to prose segments.

Fixed an enterprise network connectivity issue by restoring AES-NI compile-time optimizations, which prevents Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) firewalls from incorrectly flagging and resetting TLS connections.
Fixed incorrect key strings by removing the unsupported backtab default binding and correcting invalid `pgdn` references to `pgdown` to align with Bubble Tea v2 canonical names.

title.zh-TW: 預覽與留言更順手，連結能點且不怕誤刪
title.en: Smoother review mode, clickable links, and safeguarded comments

body.zh-TW: 現在在終端機裡審閱差異與留註解變得更安全也更靈活了。以前你在註解模式打字打到一半，如果不小心按到 Esc，千辛萬苦打好的字就會瞬間灰飛煙滅；現在它會貼心跳出確認對話框攔住你。看程式碼差異時，如果你不小心按下一筆跳過了想看的地方，現在可以按 shift+n 直接「倒車」回去看上一筆。此外，現在終端機裡的網址連結真的可以點擊了，按住熱鍵點一下就能直接在瀏覽器打開；清空歷史對話畫面的快捷鍵（ctrl+o）也修好重新復活，不會再失靈。就像看實體報紙變成看電子書一樣，現在不但可以在文章上點連結，不小心翻頁還能按 shift+n 退回，而且寫在旁邊的便條紙也不會因為風吹就飛走。
body.en: Reviewing diffs and leaving comments in the terminal is now safer and more flexible. Previously, if you accidentally hit Esc while halfway through typing a comment, your hard work would instantly vanish into thin air; now, a thoughtful confirmation dialog pops up to stop you. When reviewing code changes, if you accidentally skip past a section you wanted to see, you can now press shift+n to instantly "reverse" back to the previous diff block. Furthermore, web links in the terminal are now genuinely clickable—just hold the modifier key and click to open them straight in your browser. The shortcut for clearing the conversation history screen (ctrl+o) has also been resurrected and fixed. Like upgrading from a physical newspaper to an e-book: you can now tap links on the page, instantly flip back if you turn a page by mistake, and your sticky notes won't blow away in the wind.

title.zh-TW: 啟動專案更直覺，設定檔優先順序與企業連線不再雷人
title.en: Intuitive project launching, smarter config priorities, and reliable enterprise connections

body.zh-TW: 你可以更直接地管理並啟動不同專案了。現在只要在啟動時加上 `--project` 或 `--new-project`，就能直接指定或建立專案，不用管你現在人在哪個資料夾。設定檔的優先順序也變聰明了，專案專屬的權限設定現在會確實蓋過全域設定，不會再發生「明明專案設定了卻不理我」的窘境。如果你在公司裡使用，以前因為企業防火牆的深度封包檢測（DPI）會誤擋系統的加密連線，導致你一直斷線；現在系統找回了最佳化設定，連線能順利穿透防火牆了。另外，系統也不會再自作聰明把你寫在程式碼區塊裡的 Makefile 語法當成數學公式亂改一通了。就像去不同的分公司上班，現在你只要報上分公司名字就能直接上工，當地的員工守則會確實蓋過總公司的規定，而且公司的門禁系統也不會再把你的正常公事包誤認為危險物品而被警衛攔下。
body.en: Managing and launching different projects is now much more straightforward. By simply adding the `--project` or `--new-project` flags at startup, you can directly specify or create a project without worrying about which folder you are currently in. Config priorities are also smarter now: project-specific permission settings will reliably override global settings, ending the frustration of "I set it for this project but it's ignoring me." If you use the tool at a corporate office, Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) firewalls used to falsely block the system's encrypted connections causing endless disconnects; optimizations have now been restored so traffic passes smoothly through the firewall. body.zh-TW: 現在終端機裡的文字與畫面排版更友善了。當系統跳出工具確認對話框問你要不要執行指令時，你可以按 ctrl+g 切換到全螢幕模式，舒舒服服地查看並編輯完整指令和權限，不再只能擠在原本小小的單行修改框裡。指令輸出的高度現在會自動調整，你甚至可以用 AGY_CLI_CMD_OUTPUT_PERCENTAGE 這個環境變數（設定程式環境的參數）來控制它最多能佔畫面的幾成。文字排版時也不會再發生「網址裡有連字號就被硬生生切成兩半」的糗事。在看版本控制（VCS，像是 Git 紀錄）的樹狀圖時，代表當前位置的 `@` 符號現在會精準標示在你真正所在的版本上，不會再跑去標記「還沒存檔的工作區」，讓你一眼看出自己到底在哪裡。就像看電影時，以前字幕遇到長網址會被隨便切斷，重點片段只能在小視窗看，現在不但字幕排版完美，遇到重要確認還能按 ctrl+g 放大到全螢幕看個仔細。
body.en: The text and layout in the terminal are now much friendlier. When the tool confirmation dialog pops up asking if you want to run a command, you can press ctrl+g to switch to a full-screen view, allowing you to comfortably inspect and edit the entire command and its permissions rather than cramming into a tiny single-line box. Command output heights now adjust dynamically, and you can even set a maximum terminal height percentage using the AGY_CLI_CMD_OUTPUT_PERCENTAGE environment variable (a parameter used to configure the program's environment). When viewing the version control system (VCS, like Git) tree history, the `@` marker representing your current position now accurately highlights your actual committed state, rather than pointing to the uncommitted "Working Copy", letting you see exactly where you stand. Like watching a movie: the subtitles used to awkwardly chop long URLs in half, and crucial scenes were forced into a tiny window; now the subtitles are perfectly formatted, and you can instantly expand important prompts to full-screen to read every detail clearly.

body.en: Browsing code version history in the terminal is now a much more pleasant experience. Previously, viewing Git history just gave you a plain text list; now, it draws beautiful ASCII node graphs (using lines to show branching and merging), letting you understand the flow of versions at a glance. As you scroll through the history, the side panel immediately loads and displays exactly which files were changed and what the diffs are, without requiring extra clicks to open them. Moreover, the system is smarter now: even if you only give it a short 6-character version hash, it instantly resolves it to the full 64-character version you meant. Like looking through a family tree: instead of just staring at a wall of drawers with names, you now get a clear diagram of bloodlines, and simply pulling a drawer instantly reveals that person's entire life story right beside it — and you can accurately find anyone just by calling out their nickname.

title.zh-TW: 解決權限鬼打牆與 Windows 登入卡關問題
title.en: Fixes infinite permission loops and Windows login hurdles

body.zh-TW: 已同意的指令不會再反覆跳權限詢問。以前你明明同意了某個指令權限，但因為系統沒把指令裡的特殊符號（像 $ 或 .）當作普通文字處理，導致它一直認不出你同意過，不停跳出警告鬼打牆；現在這些符號都會被正確辨識了，而且你在設定裡選了「每次都要問」的權限也不會在更新設定檔時被偷偷刪掉。對於 Windows 使用者，現在需要登入時，系統會自動幫你順利叫出瀏覽器畫面，不用再手動複製網址；在執行指令時也不會再遇到因為符號沒處理好導致輸出被默默吞掉的狀況，預設也會改用 PowerShell 來執行了。另外，這次也改善了對 ARM64 設備（像是樹莓派 Raspberry Pi 4B）的相容性。就像去銀行辦事，以前你明明蓋了章，行員卻因為你的印章花紋太複雜而一直叫你重蓋，現在機器終於換新了，不但能精準辨識印章，甚至幫你把本來卡住的號碼牌機也修好了。
body.en: Several blood-pressure-raising system issues have been ironed out. Previously, even if you explicitly approved a command's permission, the system would fail to treat special characters (like $ or .) as plain text, constantly failing to recognize your approval and trapping you in an endless loop of permission prompts; these characters are now correctly escaped, and permissions marked "ask" won't secretly get deleted when your settings file updates. For Windows users, when authentication is required, the system now automatically and smoothly pops open your browser, saving you from manually copying URLs. Also, command outputs on Windows will no longer be silently swallowed due to poor argument escaping, and PowerShell is now the default shell. Finally, compatibility with ARM64 devices (like the Raspberry Pi 4B) has been improved. Like dealing with bank paperwork: you used to clearly stamp your seal, but the clerk kept making you re-stamp it because the pattern was "too complex"; now they've upgraded their scanner to recognize it perfectly, and they even fixed the broken queue ticket machine while they were at it.
